text: This report requests that City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 57 Pegasus Trail. The application indicates the reason for removal is to address concerns over the declining health of the tree, damage to cars caused by falling debris, and damage to the driveway. The subject tree is a white pine (Pinus strobus), measuring 46 cm in diameter. The Private Tree By-law does not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable.
City Council on October 27, 28 and 30, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 57 Pegasus Trail.
